mentions.name: Aura Distill
mentions.description: A memory system for AI agents that encodes memories so they can handle ambiguity and contradictions, going beyond simple 'memory' features for personal AI agents. Framed as first-principles thinking for AI agents.
mentions.problem: Simple 'memory' for personal AI agents cannot encode memories in a way that handles ambiguity and contradictions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
my main project is https://auradistill.com: First-principles thinking for your AI agents.

It's not just about giving your personal AI agents "memory". It's about encoding memories in a way that can handle ambiguity and contradictions.
